text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you experience any diarrhea, abdominal pain, or muscle aches alongside the fever? Have you noticed any changes in your baby's movement or any vaginal bleeding?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the history of ice cream consumption and current symptoms, I suspect a foodborne infection. REQUEST TEST: Stool_Culture
